approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content, with file-grounded project questions modeled on Trunk Tools.
notes: Reproduce an Email sender name swapped with the cited recipient while the addresses remain absent from the answer.
Keep each explicit participant display name equal to one complete same-role From, To, Cc, Bcc or Reply-To Email header value.
Reject name recombination, role swaps and cross-Email source-finding borrowing.
Do not treat an RFI or Submittal form's From or To field as an Email participant header.
Require an explicit supported role value when an answered sender or recipient question uses Email evidence.
Reuse Python's standard-library mailbox parser and add no runtime dependency or provider request.
Use synthetic evidence and make no provider request.
title: Ground Email participant display names
objective: Prevent Email participant names from being omitted, recombined, role-swapped or borrowed across source findings while retaining exact readable sender and recipient output.
